'''Friedrich Engel''' (26 December 1861 &ndash; 29 September 1941) was a German [[mathematician]].

Engel was born in [[Lugau]], [[Kingdom of Saxony|Saxony]], as the son of a [[Lutheran]] pastor. He attended the Universities of both [[University of Leipzig|Leipzig]] and [[University of Berlin|Berlin]], before receiving his [[doctorate]] from Leipzig in 1883.

Engel studied under [[Felix Klein]] at Leipzig, and collaborated with [[Sophus Lie]] for much of his life. He worked at Leipzig (1885–1904), [[University of Greifswald|Greifswald]] (1904–1913), and [[University of Giessen|Giessen]] (1913–1931). He died in Giessen.

Engel was the co-author, with Sophus Lie, of the three volume work ''Theorie der Transformationsgruppen'' (publ. 1888–1893; tr., "Theory of transformation groups"). Engel was the editor of the collected works<ref>{{cite journal|author=Carmichael, R. D.|authorlink=Robert Daniel Carmichael|title=Volume III of Lie's Memoirs|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1923|volume=29|issue=8|pages=367–369|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1923-29-08/S0002-9904-1923-03758-0/|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1923-03758-0|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Carmichael, R. D.|title=Sophus Lie's ''Gesammelte Abhandlungen'' (Vol. 4)|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1930|volume=36|issue=5|page=337|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1930-36-05/S0002-9904-1930-04950-2/|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1930-04950-2|doi-access=free}}</ref> of Sophus Lie with six volumes published between 1922 and 1937; the seventh and final volume was prepared for publication but appeared almost twenty years after Engel's death. He was also the editor of the collected works of [[Hermann Grassmann]].<ref>{{cite journal|author=Wilson, E. B.|authorlink=Edwin Bidwell Wilson|title=Review: ''Hermann Grassmanns gesammelte mathematische und physikalische Werke. Herausgegeben von FRIEDRICH ENGEL''.|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1915|volume=22|issue=3|pages=149–150|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1915-22-03/S0002-9904-1915-02746-1/|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1915-02746-1|doi-access=free}}</ref> Engel translated the works of [[Nikolai Lobachevski]] from Russian into German, thus making these works more accessible. With [[Paul Stäckel]] he wrote a history of [[non-Euclidean geometry]] (''Theorie der Parallellinien von Euklid bis auf Gauss'', 1895). With his former student Karl Faber, he wrote a book on the theory of [[partial differential equation]]s of the first order using methods of [[Lie group]] theory.<ref>{{cite journal|author=Wintner, Aurel|authorlink=Aurel Wintner|title=Review: Friedriech Engel, ''Die Liesche Theorie der partiellen Differentialgleichungen der erster Ordnung''|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1933|volume=39|issue=3|pages=183–184|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1933-39-03/S0002-9904-1933-05564-7/|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1933-05564-7|doi-access=free}}</ref> In 1910 Engel was the president of the [[Deutsche Mathematiker-Vereinigung]].
